logline: Above the clouds a shattered futuristic city floats in a lightning storm; Kuro and Seren face each other on a cracked platform as wind tears at coat and hair and their auras flare.
styleReference: Premium cinematic anime: dramatic cel shading, atmospheric perspective over clouds, rich red-gold contrast, impact frames, speed ramps. No narration, no subtitles, no logos.
props: katana of dark energy; twin celestial blades; storm clouds; lightning; wind in the coat and hair; aura glow

cast.name: Kuro
cast.reference: Silver-haired swordsman, long black coat with glowing crimson markings, katana forged from dark energy.

cast.name: Seren
cast.reference: Female warrior, flowing white hair, golden eyes, elegant black-and-gold armor, a pair of luminous celestial blades.
